heroHeading: Practical expertise for organizations seeking to grow their impact.
heroParagraph: From prospecting to stewardship, I support the full resource mobilization journey.

services.title: Donor Mapping & Prospecting
services.description: Researching and identifying compatible bilateral donors, foundations and corporate partners based on organizational priorities, geography and funding interests.

services.title: Proposal Development
services.description: Writing and coordinating grant applications, concept notes and logical frameworks that translate ideas into clear, compelling funding propositions.

services.title: Partnership Management
services.description: Building and nurturing long-term relationships with stakeholders, governments, NGOs and other strategic partners.

services.title: Fundraising Strategy
services.description: Designing comprehensive roadmaps that strengthen financial sustainability, diversify funding sources and create a more resilient resource base.

services.title: Private Sector Engagement
services.description: Creating corporate social responsibility initiatives and public-private partnerships that align business interests with meaningful social impact.

services.title: Donor Stewardship
services.description: Supporting reporting, communication and impact tracking to strengthen donor relationships and encourage continued support.

ctaText: Let's discuss your organization's goals and identify where partnerships or resource mobilization can create the greatest value.
